title: Science Undergraduate Laboratory Internships (SULI)
org: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
summary: Paid research internships at DOE national laboratories: 10 weeks in summer, or a fall or spring semester. Check the official Key Dates page for this cycle's deadline and the eligibility rules.

title: Community College Internships (CCI)
org: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
summary: Paid 10-week technical internships at DOE national laboratories for community college students. Summer 2027 applications are due January 6, 2027 at 5:00 PM Eastern.

title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
org: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
summary: Paid 11-week summer research fellowship (2026 stipend about $710 a week, with housing and travel help). Open to full-time undergraduates at accredited US 2- or 4-year colleges, first-years through graduating seniors. Applications go through USAJOBS; student deadline January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM Eastern.

title: NASA OSTEM Internships (summer 2027)
summary: Short-term paid internships at NASA centers. Applicants must be US citizens, at least 18, with a GPA of 3.0 or higher. Summer 2027 deadline March 1, 2027; fall 2027 deadline May 24, 2027.

title: Ernest F. Hollings Undergraduate Scholarship
summary: Academic support of up to $9,500 a year for two years, plus a paid 10-week NOAA summer internship ($700 a week). Applications open through January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM Eastern.
pay: $700 a week internship + up to $9,500 a year

title: Amgen Scholars (US program)
summary: Summer research program in science and biotechnology at host universities. Summer 2027 applications are due February 1, 2027. Check the US program page for stipend and eligibility. Host universities include Howard University, an HBCU.

title: SMART Scholarship-for-Service
summary: Full tuition, a yearly stipend and summer internships, followed by a job with the Department of War after graduation. Check the official site for this cycle's dates and eligibility.

title: NASA MUREP (Minority University Research and Education Project)
summary: NASA's program for HBCUs, Tribal Colleges and other minority-serving institutions: research funding for schools and opportunities for their students. Check the page for current student opportunities.
